-- Append to the current AxiomGate source after importing StructuralAssurance.
-- These checks inspect its private policy rows without adding a public API.

namespace Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField

noncomputable def generatedSemanticChoiceProbe : Nat :=
  Classical.choice (show Nonempty Nat from ⟨17⟩)

end Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField

namespace Effect4Test.Audit

run_elab do
  let environment ← Lean.getEnv
  let auditModule := `Effect4Test.Schema.StructuralAssurance
  let targetModule := `Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField
  let expectedPublic :=
    [ ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.source?
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.generate?
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.source_contains_directional_rows
    ]
  let mut failures : Array String := #[]
  unless auditImplementationModules.contains auditModule do
    failures := failures.push "StructuralAssurance is missing its exact audit implementation admission"
  if choiceImplementationModules.contains targetModule then
    failures := failures.push "EffectfulField has a forbidden blanket module exemption"
  for name in expectedPublic do
    unless choiceImplementationDeclarations.contains name do
      failures := failures.push s!"rendering declaration missing exact admission: {name}"
  let mut auditNeedsChoice := false
  for (name, _) in environment.constants.toList do
    if moduleOf? environment name == some auditModule then
      let axioms ← collectAxioms name
      if axioms.contains ``Classical.choice then
        auditNeedsChoice := true
      unless axioms.all auditImplementationAxioms.contains do
        failures := failures.push s!"audit implementation exceeds its ceiling: {name}"
  unless auditNeedsChoice do
    failures := failures.push "StructuralAssurance admission is stale or the actual module was not imported"
  unless failures.isEmpty do
    throwError "implementation boundary regression(s):\n{String.intercalate "\n" failures.toList}"
  logInfo "PASS exact audit module and public rendering admissions"

run_elab do
  let environment ← Lean.getEnv
  let declarations := environment.constants.toList.toArray.map Prod.fst
  let admitted ← match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment declarations with
    | .ok names => pure names
    | .error error => throwError "could not resolve exact implementation admissions: {error}"
  let targetModule := `Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField
  let privateSpelling := `Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.directionalRowsPresent
  let privateMatches := declarations.filter fun name =>
    moduleOf? environment name == some targetModule &&
      privateToUserName name == privateSpelling
  unless privateMatches.size == 1 do
    throwError "expected exactly one owned directionalRowsPresent declaration, found {privateMatches.size}"
  let privateName := privateMatches[0]!
  unless (choiceImplementationPrivateDeclarations.filter
      (· == (targetModule, privateSpelling))).length == 1 do
    throwError "private rendering admission must name exactly its owning module and declaration spelling, exactly once"
  let expected :=
    [ ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.source?
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.generate?
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.source_contains_directional_rows
    , privateName
    ]
  let actual := admitted.filter fun name => moduleOf? environment name == some targetModule
  unless actual.length == expected.length &&
      expected.all actual.contains && actual.all expected.contains do
    throwError "EffectfulField implementation admission must contain exactly the four rendering declarations"
  for name in expected do
    let axioms ← collectAxioms name
    unless axioms.contains ``Classical.choice do
      throwError "stale rendering admission no longer needs Classical.choice: {name}"
    unless axioms.all auditImplementationAxioms.contains do
      throwError "rendering admission exceeds its implementation ceiling: {name}"
  match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment
      (declarations.filter fun name => name != privateName) with
  | .error _ => pure ()
  | .ok _ => throwError "missing private rendering declaration was silently admitted"
  match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment (declarations.push privateName) with
  | .error _ => pure ()
  | .ok _ => throwError "duplicate private rendering declaration was silently admitted"
  let semanticNames :=
    [ ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.requestReady
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.RequestReady
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.requestReady_iff
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.decl?
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.module?
    , ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.decl?_never_raw
    ]
  for name in semanticNames do
    if admitted.contains name ||
        (moduleOf? environment name).any choiceImplementationModules.contains then
      throwError "semantic admission or lowering received an implementation exemption: {name}"
    unless (← collectAxioms name).all allowedAxioms.contains do
      throwError "semantic admission or lowering exceeds the base ceiling: {name}"
  let planted := ``Effect4.Target.TypeScript.EffectfulField.generatedSemanticChoiceProbe
  unless (← collectAxioms planted).contains ``Classical.choice do
    throwError "the fresh semantic probe no longer tests Classical.choice"
  let plantedBound :=
    if (moduleOf? environment planted).any choiceImplementationModules.contains ||
        admitted.contains planted then
      auditImplementationAxioms
    else allowedAxioms
  unless !(← collectAxioms planted).all plantedBound.contains do
    throwError "fresh choice-bearing semantic helper received an implementation exemption"
  logInfo "PASS exact private resolution, rendering receipts, and base ceiling for semantic declarations"
  logInfo "PASS fresh choice-bearing semantic helper exceeds its selected ceiling"

-- The two bridge theorems the deleted `targetImplementationModules` used to
-- cover. They say Effect4's emitter IS the pinned `typescript` package's
-- emitter, node for node, and the comment justifying the blanket admission
-- claimed the module "declares no theorem". They are clean; this is the gate
-- proving it rather than a comment asserting it.
run_elab do
  let environment ← Lean.getEnv
  let declarations := environment.constants.toList.toArray.map Prod.fst
  let admitted ← match resolveChoiceImplementationDeclarations environment declarations with
    | .ok names => pure names
    | .error error => throwError "could not resolve exact implementation admissions: {error}"
  let skeletonModule := `Effect4.Target.TypeScript.Skeleton
  if choiceImplementationModules.contains skeletonModule then
    throwError "the skeleton module has a blanket exemption again; the bridge theorems are inside it"
  let bridges :=
    [ ``Effect4.Target.EffectV4.Structuring.emitNode_eq
    , ``Effect4.Target.EffectV4.Structuring.emitWith_eq
    ]
  for name in bridges do
    if admitted.contains name then
      throwError "the emitter bridge theorem received an implementation exemption: {name}"
    unless (moduleOf? environment name) == some skeletonModule do
      throwError "the emitter bridge theorem moved out of the skeleton module: {name}"
    unless (← collectAxioms name).all allowedAxioms.contains do
      throwError "the emitter bridge theorem exceeds the base ceiling: {name}"
  logInfo "PASS the emitter bridge theorems are unadmitted and at the base ceiling"

end Effect4Test.Audit
